4802: A quiet, shy, and unassuming high school student who has a long-suppressed ability to talk to cats. [From Wikipedia]
4803: As the owner of the strange "Cat Bureau", he is known as a helper to all. He is an artisan's statue that somehow has been brought to life.
4804: A beautiful white servant cat of the Cat Kingdom.
6152: A fat, cynical cat who leads Haru to the Baron.
7420: Haru’s best friend who, unlike Haru, seems to have things pretty planned out.
7421: A statue of a raven who comes alive, much like the Baron. Though friends with Muta, he enjoys making cynical comments at the latter's expense.
7422: The Cat King is fat and deranged and is instantly devoted to Haru and quickly becomes over-protective of her and refuses to listen to her protests at marrying Lune. When she tries to escape he gives chase, seemingly oblivious to her unwillingness to go through with the wedding.
7423: Prince of the Cat Kingdom and, he is the entire opposite of his father, The Cat King. He is unaware of the schemings of his father; when he discovers his father's plan, he steps in to save the day.
7424: A determined cat who is endlessly running after Haru, he is a high-standing servant of the King and is blissfully ignorant of the havoc he wreaks in kidnapping Haru. He is a classic lackey and yes-man. (In the original and most other dubs, Natoru has a distinct female voice.)
7425: The Cat King's elderly and extremely loyal adviser, he is not entirely trustful of the King's arranged marriage and does his best to quietly stop it. Unfortunately, Natoru is constantly getting under foot and ruining his plans.
11278: She is the mother of Haru.
